terms.comment: The blessing given by a priest or a parent, or over food; first praise of God, then a blessing (Lewis & Short). For a blessing in the sense of a godsend, Latin says a gift of God: bonum datum deōrum concessū atque mūnere (Cic. Univ. 14, Lewis & Short s.v. mūnus).

phrases.latin: Aperīs tū manum tuam, et implēs omne animal benedictiōne.
phrases.english: You open your hand and fill every living thing with blessing (the grace before meals).
That was a rather short blessing (of a farmer whose grace was just the sign of the cross).

sources: Lewis & Short: benedictio · Lewis & Short: munus
